title: Fix three bugs in a Go index-based Stack
description: Fix bugs in Stack: Peek accesses data[top+1] (OOB) instead of data[top], Size returns top instead of top+1, IsEmpty checks top==0 instead of top==-1.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in stack.go:
1. Peek: change `s.data[s.top+1]` to `s.data[s.top]`
2. Size: change `return s.top` to `return s.top + 1`
3. IsEmpty: change `s.top == 0` to `s.top == -1` (or `s.top < 0`)
All 3 test cases must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
